title: Real-input tests via XTEST/xdotool under Xvfb to close the synthetic click/key gap
description: M2 shipped click/key controllers with plumbing-only live tests because the binding has no way to synthesise a GdkEvent (pre-flight correction 1). An xdotool/XTEST-driven live test (Xvfb, presented window, xdotool click/key at the widget's allocation) would exercise GTK's real routing end to end — the only change that closes the gap rather than compensating for it (gallery Input page, Task 16 click-through). From task-13-review.md's re-review.
